comment: The files model-refresh may rewrite. Anything not listed here is read for context and never edited. Vendor skills are excluded on purpose: see README, 'Why the vendor skills are not owned'.

vendored.comment: Installed from marketplaces or upstream repos. Empty since 2026-10-18: the vendor skills now live in the Claude account, which syncs them to every machine. A skill vendored here again is listed so a refresh run names it as skipped.
